page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server belonging to the ecs.r7 instance family. Built on the KVM hypervisor platform, this instance delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock frequency of 2.7 GHz on x86_64 architecture. System memory provisions stand at 512 GB of RAM, establishing a resource density of 8.0 GB RAM per dedicated vCPU core.

Network throughput for the instance reaches a 32 Gbps baseline capability, accommodating high-volume inter-service communication and enterprise data exchanges. The server does not bundle local disk storage, requiring external block storage attachments for persistent data retention. It also does not feature discrete GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio minimizes resource waste in environments requiring extensive memory capacity relative to compute cores. Suitable workload fits include large in-memory caching tiers, high-concurrency relational databases, real-time analytics platforms, and enterprise resource planning software.
